criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 2, 8 and 9 clear the bold test. Frame 4's arm is a toy of primitives on a mid grey floor, frame 5 a beige slab with a rubber band mark, frame 7 an embossed I glyph calendar tile, frame 6 two flat trays under a dead band, frame 1's lower right copper smooth with stepped dome rings.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Clearly one piece: one key, one button motif, one material vocabulary, a value arc from glow to cold steel. The navy room alternates with the black relief field, and frame 5 sits outside the dark register.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and attribution discipline is good. Held down by: slide 5's co-originator assertion not in the stored quotes of c13 and c15; the first comment's 'Day counts computed in compute.py' when the deck computes months; slide 9's cite line listing c23 with nothing on the slide stating it; every foundry fact resting on the university's own releases.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What and who paid are clear. No place below Texas A&M, no date, frame 9 gives no route.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The hook works and frame 2 pays. The argument's motive arrives at frame 8, frame 5 could move, the real turn is frame 6's switch to the separate award.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register with characterful headlines, clerkly deks, no Texas texture, the department never named.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A new palette and world. The one unit counted in a grid spine repeats nos. 62 to 64, and frame 7's calendar grid repeats nos. 52 and 64.

one_sentence_fix: Make frame 9 a real 'what a reader can do' with ARM-MIP's access page and PhaseForge's repository, and name College Station from the NSF record.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A toy arm of cylinders and boxes, plain primitives, a mid grey floor.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Filleted castings, joint housings and a cable run, tight on the gripper over the glowing pocket, the floor outside the pool to black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A beige slab in the grey middle, a thick flat ring for the mark.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Near edge on so only the sheet edges catch the key, a thin paint pen stroke.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: 72 dogbones at relief height 10 read as an embossed calendar tile, a hard plate edge, labels outside the safe zone.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Real height with fillets, an oblique crop bleeding off the right and bottom, labels inside the margin.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Two flat trays under a dead band, a vent grille at feed size.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower and push in so the 249 tray bleeds off the right, scuffed bevelled tops, the pool on the 41 filled wells.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A smooth tan lower right gradient, stepped dome rings.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Milled arc roughness, more dome segments.
